description.summary: An orb of pure darkness explodes from within the target creature, dealing 1d6 points of shadow damage per caster level (maximum 20d6).
description.value: An orb of pure darkness explodes from within the target creature, dealing 1d6 points of shadow damage per caster level (maximum 20d6). In addition, the target takes 2 Strength damage, 2 Dexterity damage, 2 Constitution damage, 2 Wisdom damage, 2 Intelligence damage, and 2 Charisma damage. Attribute damage wears off after 1 week on its own or may be cured by appropriate magicks. A successful Fortitude save negates attribute damage. This spell was submitted as a part of the SCC for September 2020 by JIMMEH the Bear
